evidence.claim: AI names down 30-50% from highs; money rotating out of AI into financials/healthcare/staples in stages ('anti-bubble mania'); crowded hedge-fund longs degrossing
evidence.relation: crowding unwind -> continued short-term underperformance of AI index

evidence.claim: AI boom yr 3.9 vs dotcom 5.3; NDX +137% vs dotcom +1000%; NVDA fwd PE 17 vs Cisco 131 at peak — boom structurally early
evidence.relation: duration/valuation analogy -> long-run upside, weak signal for 90-day horizon

evidence.source: Adam Khoo — Hyperscalers Crash After Earnings (Oct 30)
evidence.claim: Hyperscaler negative FCF = growth capex + one-offs (EU fine, TPU inventory), NOT declining operating cash flow; rev growth GOOGL+25% META+26% AMZN+13%
evidence.relation: growth capex -> future operating cash flow up; fundamentals intact despite price drop

resolution: Short-term rotation-out evidence (qqq-1) vs fundamental-intact evidence (qqq-3) genuinely conflict; both kept. Resolution: rotation is a flow phenomenon (weeks), fundamentals a valuation phenomenon (quarters). For the 90-day view the flow leg dominates while Fed-hike odds (already in prior) suppress multiples — posterior stays near neutral, slightly above the pre-evidence market wash because earnings breadth data is the strongest verified fact in the set.
